title: Producing a tone and Jim Horowitz's lip exercises
summary: Punch describes how hard it was to get his low notes and the exercises his teacher gave him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

and all that that you know. And I couldn't get this note. That's not what I couldn't get. It took me a long time to get that note. Whatever the scales come from you know. But I couldn't get this. I kept on feeling till I come and loosen up on my lip you know and
you got that little note. But what I'm getting at is you can make a note like. No no just with your lip what kind of noise do you make? Who taught you that? Jim Horowitz. What did you do before that?
